editorial.blurb: Turkish Doner brings authentic, expertly-crafted döner and shawarma to the U.S., earning genuine raves from diners impressed by both the quality and the warmth of the welcome.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Turkish beef döner or Slavic beef shawarma with turshu (pickled vegetables) on the side — reviewers rave about the juiciness and suggest pairing it with the little peppers for extra flavor.

topDishes.note: Reviewers call it the best döner they've had in the U.S.
Super juicy and flavorful, especially with pickled vegetables
Loved every bite, shared dining at its finest
